description: Carnet de Padres helps adult parents and caregivers find Spanish-language educational resources for everyday family life. Explore 35 age-based routes from pregnancy to age 18 and 18 Alma activities about emotions and living together. Search by topic and age, read a practical action, an adaptable phrase or an activity, and check the source. Five resources also include attributed complementary readings from external institutions. These selections do not imply institutional review or endorsement. These resources provide educational guidance, not diagnosis, treatment or clinical assessment. Alma adaptations do not claim accredited professional review. The plugin does not manage accounts, purchases or access to private courses or books.
